title: Harshavardhana
hook: Harshavardhana: Antim bade Hindu samrat (V.A. Smith)
exam_points: Narmada par Pulakeshin II se haar (Aihole abhilekh, Ravikirti).
Xuanzang (c. 630-643 CE) ne yatra ki; Kannauj sabha aur Prayag ka 'Mahamoksha Parishad'.
Natak: Ratnavali, Priyadarshika, Nagananda; Bana ki 'Harshacharita'.
Banskhera (628 CE) aur Madhuban (631 CE) tamra-patra.

mcqs.q: Harsha ko Narmada par kisne haraya?
